summary: Phase C CRM preset templates verified end-to-end. Backend: pytest test_crm_settings.py (2/2 passing) + live smoke via curl on Bright Beans (pro@axiom.ai) covering all 3 presets, defaults, PATCH partial/validation, apply-preset errors. critical_code_review_comments: crm_settings.PATCH: when 'stage_labels' is provided as an empty {} or values are all blank strings, the merged dict silently keeps prior values — that is the documented behavior (whitelist keys, ignore invalid values) but may confuse callers expecting a full replace; consider a debug log.

useCrmSettings uses a module-level Map cache with no invalidation trigger on apply-preset from other tabs; a small event/pubsub or window 'crm-settings-updated' listener would remove the need for hard reloads across pages.
CrmSettings.jsx uses native window.confirm() — works but breaks in playwright unless dialog handler is attached; not a bug, just call out for E2E consumers.
